title: Yojouhan Shinwa Taikei Specials
justification: AniList 8985 has 3 episodes (2010-08-20 to 2010-11-26); the offline database synonyms call it 'TV Mihouei Episode' / 'Unaired Episodes'. AniDB 7243 S1-S3 are 'Land Submarine, to the South Pole' (2010-08-20), 'Land Submarine, to the Women's Bath' (2010-10-22), 'Land Submarine of Love and Fishing' (2010-11-26): the three unaired episodes, three dates matching AniList start/end. TVDB 140751 0x01-0x03 carry exactly those titles on those dates. S4 'Kyoto Guide' shares S1's date 2010-08-20 but is a separate promotional piece and is not consecutive after S3, so it is excluded.
